title: Scalar extension respects direct-image geometric exchange
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings and let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}X'&\xrightarrow h&X\\ f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow g&Y\end{array}$$
be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with the canonical adjunctions $u_R^{-1}\dashv Ru_*^R$ for $R=A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $S_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T:D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let
$\lambda_u:u_B^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tu_A^{-1}$, for $u:T\to V$, be the canonical tensor inverse-image comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], sending the inverse image of $x\otimes b$ to $u^{-1}x\otimes b$ on K-flat representatives. Define $\chi_u:S_VRu_*^A\to Ru_*^BS_T$ to be the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $\lambda_u$ under $u_A^{-1}\dashv Ru_*^A$ and $u_B^{-1}\dashv Ru_*^B$. Write $\operatorname{Ex}^R:g_R^{-1}Rf_*^R\to Rf'_*{}^Rh_R^{-1}$ for the ambient ringed exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] for constant ring $R$. For every $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ the following equality holds in $D(Y'_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$:
$$Rf'_*{}^B(\lambda_{h,M})\circ\operatorname{Ex}^B_{S_XM}\circ g_B^{-1}(\chi_{f,M})
=\chi_{f',h_A^{-1}M}\circ S_{Y'}(\operatorname{Ex}^A_M)\circ\lambda_{g,Rf_*^AM}.$$
Both sides run from $g_B^{-1}S_YRf_*^AM$ to $Rf'_*{}^BS_{X'}h_A^{-1}M$. The equality is natural in $M$; no properness, boundedness, constructibility, Tor-amplitude or flatness hypothesis on $A\to B$ is imposed.
